name: Alliances
description: Adds Alliances as an independently enabled expansion: 144 distinct cards across 199 published printings. Its banner medallion lives under Deck Builder Extras, leaving the original set strip unchanged.
rules_note: No other numbered pack is required. The ZIP provides metadata and artwork, never executable scripts. SIMPLIFIED: Fatal Lore, Library of Lat-Nam and Misfortune choose their opponent-controlled mode on resolution; Fatal Lore also selects its creatures then. See Help and docs/simplified-cards.md.
